summary.text: Andy Dow is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A military veteran, historian and member of the Farmington planning board, Dow said in a Ballotpedia survey that infrastructure and education are among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Andy Dow graduated from Lawrence High School and earned an associate degree from Manchester Technical Community College in 1997 and a bachelor's degree from New England College in 2021.
Ballotpedia lists his service in the U.S. Army National Guard from 1999 to 2013 and his career experience as a historian.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Dow said he served as a military liaison officer in the rebuilding effort after Hurricane Katrina, served in Iraq during the surge, and recorded the war as a military historian.

Dow said he is a stained-glass craftsman recognized by the League of NH Craftsmen, that since 2018 he has established and donated a political archive at New England College, and that he has served on Farmington's planning board for two years.
He said in the survey that the district needs infrastructure development that does not raise taxes and listed education as a priority.
